incidents.summary: Serco admitted responsibility for fraud and false accounting related to electronic tagging and settled associated investor litigation in 2024 on undisclosed terms.

sources.title: Serco to pay £23m after Serious Fraud Office probe into MoJ electronic tagging scandal
sources.quote: Outsourcer Serco has agreed to pay £22.9m and admitted responsibility for three offences of fraud and two of false accounting related to its work to deliver an electronic tagging scheme on behalf of the Ministry of Justice.

sources.title: Serco settles landmark lawsuit linked to overcharging scandal
sources.quote: After it came out, Serco agreed to repay £68.5m to the UK government for overcharging to tag criminals.

sources.title: Serco settles landmark lawsuit linked to overcharging scandal
sources.quote: After years of waiting, the trial kicked off last week, but it was revealed today that Serco had settled with the shareholder group.
